scripts.lint: vp run --filter "./packages/*" build && vp run --filter "./packages/*" lint
scripts.test: vp run --filter "./packages/*" build && vp run --filter "./packages/*" test
scripts.test-e2e: vp run --filter "./packages/*" build && vp run --filter "./packages/*" test-e2e
scripts.version: vp run build && changeset version && vp install --no-frozen-lockfile
